source: controlPlaneJWTAuthenticationJWKSource as a URL is a nimbus RemoteJWKSet (BoundedResourceRetriever, DefaultJWKSetCache): fetched lazily on the first token, cached, refetched when a token's kid is not in the cached set

steps.note: the JWK set host starts empty
the host serves a set holding only the P-256 key
no credentials: rejected before any key is needed
nothing fetched yet: the remote set is read lazily
an ES256 token whose kid is in the remote set verifies (first fetch)
the same token again: answered from the cached set
one fetch so far
the host drops the P-256-only set
and serves the full set instead
cached kid: still no fetch
still one fetch
an ES384 token whose kid is absent from the cached set forces a refetch, which finds it
the RSA 4096 key came with that refetch
two fetches
a token without a kid matching nothing in the cache: no refetch
still two fetches
an ES384 token without a kid: the first cached EC key is P-256, whose verifier refuses ES384
the host stops serving the set (404)
an unknown kid forces a refetch, which fails on the 404
three fetches
a failed refetch keeps the cached set
